"""Analyze W7 ablation results: boxplots + Wilcoxon tests."""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OUTPUT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CSV_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "results_w7_ablation.csv"
VARIANTS = ["full_gmfrm", "binary_gating", "no_judge_severity", "staged_estimation"]
VARIANT_LABELS = {
    "full_gmfrm": "Full G-MFRM",
    "binary_gating": "Binary Gating",
    "no_judge_severity": "No Judge Severity",
    "staged_estimation": "Staged Estimation",
}
METRICS = ["theta_rmse", "theta_tau", "c_rmse"]
METRIC_LABELS = {
    "theta_rmse": r"$\theta$ RMSE",
    "theta_tau": r"$\theta$ Kendall $\tau$",
    "c_rmse": r"$c$ RMSE",
}


def load_data():
    df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)
    print(f"Loaded {len(df)} rows from {CSV_PATH}")
    print(f"Seeds: {df['seed'].nunique()}, Variants: {df['variant'].nunique()}")
    return df


def summary_stats(df):
    rows = []
    for var in VARIANTS:
        s = df[df["variant"] == var]
        row = {"variant": VARIANT_LABELS[var]}
        for m in METRICS + ["c_pearson"]:
            row[f"{m}_mean"] = s[m].mean()
            row[f"{m}_std"] = s[m].std()
        row["r_hat_max"] = s["r_hat"].max()
        row["ess_min"] = s["ess"].min()
        rows.append(row)
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    path = OUTPUT_DIR / "summary_stats.csv"
    out.to_csv(path, index=False)
    print(f"\nSummary stats -> {path}")
    print(out.to_string(index=False))
    return out


def wilcoxon_tests(df):
    baseline = df[df["variant"] == "full_gmfrm"].sort_values("seed")
    rows = []
    for var in VARIANTS[1:]:
        comp = df[df["variant"] == var].sort_values("seed")
        for m in METRICS:
            b_vals = baseline[m].values
            c_vals = comp[m].values
            try:
                stat_val, p_val = stats.wilcoxon(b_vals, c_vals)
            except Exception:
                stat_val, p_val = np.nan, np.nan
            diff = c_vals - b_vals
            effect = np.median(diff)
            direction = "better" if (m == "theta_tau" and effect > 0) or \
                        (m != "theta_tau" and effect < 0) else "worse"
            if m == "theta_tau":
                direction = "better" if effect > 0 else "worse"
            else:
                direction = "better" if effect < 0 else "worse"
            rows.append({
                "comparison": f"full_gmfrm vs {var}",
                "metric": m,
                "baseline_mean": b_vals.mean(),
                "variant_mean": c_vals.mean(),
                "median_diff": effect,
                "direction": direction,
                "W_statistic": stat_val,
                "p_value": p_val,
                "significant_005": p_val < 0.05,
            })
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    path = OUTPUT_DIR / "wilcoxon_tests.csv"
    out.to_csv(path, index=False)
    print(f"\nWilcoxon tests -> {path}")
    print(out.to_string(index=False))
    return out


def plot_ablation_boxplots(df):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.5))
    for ax, m in zip(axes, METRICS):
        data = [df[df["variant"] == v][m].values for v in VARIANTS]
        bp = ax.boxplot(data, labels=[VARIANT_LABELS[v] for v in VARIANTS],
                        patch_artist=True, widths=0.6)
        colors = ["#4C72B0", "#DD8452", "#55A868", "#C44E52"]
        for patch, c in zip(bp["boxes"], colors):
            patch.set_facecolor(c)
            patch.set_alpha(0.7)
        ax.set_title(METRIC_LABELS[m], fontsize=13)
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=30)
        ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    fig.suptitle("W7 Ablation: 20 Seeds", fontsize=14, y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    path = OUTPUT_DIR / "ablation_boxplots.pdf"
    fig.savefig(path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"\nBoxplot -> {path}")


def plot_theta_tau_boxplot(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
    data = [df[df["variant"] == v]["theta_tau"].values for v in VARIANTS]
    bp = ax.boxplot(data, labels=[VARIANT_LABELS[v] for v in VARIANTS],

    colors = ["#4C72B0", "#DD8452", "#55A868", "#C44E52"]
    for patch, c in zip(bp["boxes"], colors):
        patch.set_facecolor(c)
        patch.set_alpha(0.7)
    ax.set_ylabel(r"Kendall $\tau$ (ability recovery)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_title(r"$\theta$ Recovery: Kendall $\tau$ across 20 Seeds", fontsize=13)
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=20)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    fig.tight_layout()
    path = OUTPUT_DIR / "theta_tau_boxplot.pdf"
    fig.savefig(path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"\nTheta-tau boxplot -> {path}")


def main():
    df = load_data()
    summary_stats(df)
    wilcoxon_tests(df)
    plot_ablation_boxplots(df)
    plot_theta_tau_boxplot(df)
    print("\nDone.")

    main()
